title: Degree-one normalized comparison predicate
statement: For a closed immersion $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ [def-pur-normal-bundle], identify the conormal algebra with the direct image of functions on its relative spectrum by the affine-morphism equivalence counit [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra, lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec, def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. For a cone isomorphism $q$, define $\operatorname{ReesConeNormalized}(s,q)$ to require equality of the projections and augmentation sections and that on every ambient affine chart its pullback sends every degree-one ideal class of $a$ to $a/t$ modulo $t$. The chart maps are the existing extended-Rees gluing colimit legs.
